name: Gate Logic
concept: Three broad proof bays visually pair money with scope, response with navigation, and approval with intake without asserting a sequence.
silhouette: stacked mint, paper, and navy paired proof bays
focal_reason: Milestone payouts paired with Fixed-price only
interaction: A one-time in-view motion joins conceptual edges, keys, and gate marks; the pairing and all proof text remain visible without motion.
safety: Visual pairing is not a workflow, contract, verified response time, or payment state; claim qualifications stay adjacent.
